articles.title: Surprise! Scientists Find a Brand-New Penguin Species
articles.summary: Scientists just named the first new penguin species in over 100 years. It's a gentoo penguin that lives on the Kerguelen Islands, nearly 2,000 miles from any town. DNA showed it's actually a different species!

articles.title: This Singing Lemur Uses the Same Trick as Opera Stars
articles.summary: The indri lemur sings like an opera star — and scientists just figured out how. It opens its mouth wider for higher notes, just like trained human singers. The two species last shared an ancestor 74 million years ago!

articles.title: Your Big Brain Might Be Thanks to Fruit and Honey
articles.summary: A new study says sugary foods like fruit and honey helped our ancestors grow bigger brains. Early ancestors' brains weighed about as much as a medium apple — ours are five times heavier!
